Author: Martin von Gagern <gagern@google.com>

    Avoid out-of-bounds read in code fence detection
---
 src/document.c | 4 +++-
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/document.c b/src/document.c
index fcd1696..a504c2e 100644
--- a/src/document.c
+++ b/src/document.c
@@ -1789,8 +1789,10 @@ is_codefence(uint8_t *data, size_t size, size_t *width, uint8_t *chr)
        if (data[2] == ' ') { i++; } } }

        /* looking at the hrule uint8_t */
+       if (i + 2 >= size)
+               return 0;
        c = data[i];
-       if (i + 2 >= size || !(c=='~' || c=='`'))
+       if (!(c=='~' || c=='`'))
                return 0;

        /* the fence must be that same character */
